title: Illustration
slide_intent: Orient readers to a change of medium before introducing its rules. A distinct chapter opening helps them locate the illustration guidance.
strategic_value: Instacart can give illustration an identifiable place in the book through the same dark divider treatment used for neighboring chapters.
demonstration: A large cream chapter title stands alone on a dark green page below the small running identifiers.
practical_value: Use this divider to mark the beginning of the illustration section and separate it from the preceding photography and application examples.

content_islands.name: Running identifiers
content_islands.spec: Keep the book label, version and folio small along the top edge.

content_islands.name: Chapter title
content_islands.spec: Place Illustration in large cream type on the left of the green field. Leave open space around it.
